description: This file defines the SurfaceUpdateSchemaMatcher class, which extends SchemaMatcher to validate surface update messages, focusing on component presence and properties within a schema.

classes.name: SurfaceUpdateSchemaMatcher
classes.description: A schema matcher class that validates the presence and properties of components within a surfaceUpdate message schema.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SurfaceUpdateSchemaMatcher with component type, optional property name and value, and case insensitivity flag.

methods.name: getComponentById
methods.description: Finds a component by its ID within a list of components.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the schema to ensure it contains a surfaceUpdate message with the specified component type and property conditions.

methods.name: valueMatches
methods.description: Checks if the actual value matches the expected value, considering literal structures, arrays, and case sensitivity.
